text.en: As soon as possible, preferably within 24 h (value after 7 days unclear; within 2 weeks for sexual exposure). Start or complete the hepatitis B vaccine series per label Table 1.

text.en: Efficacy falls sharply if delayed beyond 48 h. Give with hepatitis B vaccine (3 doses of 0.5 mL).
